The structure of Mg2Ti2O5 crystallizes in triclinic symmetry with space group P1, containing nine atoms in the unit cell across nine independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mg and Ti centers each coordinated by five O neighbors, while O centers adopt four-, five-, and six-coordinate environments involving Mg, Ti, and other O neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Mg and Ti five-vertex coordination polyhedra, as well as corner-sharing between Mg five-vertex polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all nine sites.
